title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics + tracing, dashboard, and alert tuning
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Adds token-level KV cache metrics and tracing spans, a Grafana dashboard for token-cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alert thresholds for cache miss rates and tail latency. Backwards-compatible metric names.
description:
Motivation: We need better visibility into per-token costs and the KV cache behavior to diagnose expensive tail requests and regressions after recent runtime changes (related: ENG-4821). This PR adds token-level KV cache metrics, tracing spans around KV lookups and cache fill, a Grafana dashboard that correlates token cost / latency / cache-hit-rate by route, and updated alert thresholds to reduce noisy incidents while catching real regressions.

What changed (summary):
- Expose new Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_token_requests_total, redwood_kv_token_hits_total, redwood_kv_token_misses_total, redwood_kv_token_fill_duration_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_compute_cost_tokens_total. Metric names are prefixed to avoid collisions and are additive.
- Instrumentation: add tracing spans around KV cache lookup/fill (span names: kv.lookup, kv.fill) and tag spans with route_id, model, seq_len_bucket.
- Dashboard: new Grafana dashboard JSON (dashboards/obs-token-kv-cost-latency.json) with panels for token-level cost by route, KV hit/miss heatmap, tail latency by sequence length, and a Sankey-style visualization linking route -> model -> cache-hit-rate.
- Alerts: tune existing alerts and add two new alerts: KVTokenMissRate (5m, warning/critical thresholds) and TokenComputeCostRegression (30m increase guard with secondary check: eval-prom-run).
- Tests: unit tests for metric exposition, lightweight end-to-end smoke test for tracing spans, and updated dashboard test harness.

Checklist: 
- [x] Metrics names reviewed with SRE team (Liam)
- [x] Tracing tags reviewed with Observability team (Nora)
- [x] Grafana panels reviewed and validated on staging
- [x] Alerts tested with simulated load

Risk and rollout plan: Metrics are additive and do not change existing names. New alerts are scoped conservatively (higher thresholds) for the first week and will be lowered after verification. Dashboard is opt-in via the observability console import. Rollback: remove dashboard and set alerts to previous thresholds; metrics instrumentation is behind a feature flag (obs.token_kv=true) for quick toggle.

Small examples (single-line snippets included in description):
- Prometheus query for KV hit rate: sum(rate(redwood_kv_token_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_kv_token_requests_total[5m]))
- Example span tags: {"span.name":"kv.lookup", "route_id":"/v1/generate", "model":"redwood-7b", "seq_len_bucket":"0-128"}

Related: ENG-4821 (token-cost visibility), ENG-4835 (KV cache eviction metrics), SUP-9123 (customer report of high token cost).
